prepared_by: Codex collecting agent (single reviewer); independent reviewer assigned

vulnerability.title: Jenkins login endpoint accepts authentication POSTs without a CSRF crumb, allowing login CSRF

fixed_releases.verified_content: The 2.541 release commit ea9c7278 has the SECURITY-1166 commit 31598feb as an ancestor (git merge-base --is-ancestor exits 0) and the 2.528.3 release commit 40e29179 has the LTS commit 20bc304d as an ancestor; AuthenticationProcessingFilter2.java is blob 47d25d71 at both fix commits and at both release tags. In both fixed trees attemptAuthentication checks the CrumbIssuer and throws InsufficientAuthenticationException when the crumb is missing or invalid. Security1166Test asserts 401 and no authenticated session for login POSTs with no crumb or an invalid crumb, and 200 with a valid crumb in the parameter or header.

severity.numeric_level_rationale: NVD publishes a single CVSS 3.1 metric, 3.5 LOW, from the Secondary source (CISA-ADP); there is no Primary metric. OSV/GHSA repeats the same 3.5 vector and records LOW, which is the same low band. The CNA container has no CVSS metric. Every published severity level is low, so the level is consistent and the score is not averaged.

vulnerability.category_l2: The Spring Security login filter registers the POST authentication URL but never checks a CSRF crumb in attemptAuthentication, so a third-party page can submit the login form and log the victim into the attacker's account

description: Jenkins authenticates form logins through AuthenticationProcessingFilter2, a Spring Security UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter subclass whose constructor registers POST /<securityRealm.authenticationGatewayUrl> as the authentication request matcher (line 59 at 2.441) and reads j_username and j_password (61-62). At 2.441 the class overrides only successfulAuthentication and unsuccessfulAuthentication; it never overrides attemptAuthentication and never consults the configured CrumbIssuer, so the login endpoint accepts an authentication POST with no CSRF token. Any page the victim visits can therefore auto-submit a login form with the attacker's credentials (login CSRF): the victim's browser ends up authenticated as the attacker, and actions the victim subsequently takes - including entering data they believe is private - are performed in the attacker's account. The 2.541/2.528.3 fix commits 31598feb and 20bc304d add an attemptAuthentication override that, unless the AuthenticationProcessingFilter2.skipCSRFCheck system property is set, obtains the CrumbIssuer, reads the crumb from the request parameter or header, validates it and throws InsufficientAuthenticationException when it is missing or invalid; they also add the crumb hidden field to Jenkins/login.jelly and the setup wizard's authentication form. Security1166Test asserts 401 with no authenticated session for a missing or invalid crumb and 200 with a valid crumb, including the header and setup-wizard variants.

critical_operation.description: The filter registers the POST login URL and never overrides attemptAuthentication or checks a crumb, so the authentication request is processed without any CSRF protection. The fix adds precisely that override at the same class.

entry_point.description: POST /j_spring_security_check (or the configured authentication gateway URL) submitted cross-site by a page the victim visits, with the attacker's j_username / j_password and no crumb.

source_crosscheck.notes: The CNA, NVD, OSV and the GitHub advisory agree on the mechanism (the login POST is processed without a CSRF crumb, enabling login CSRF) and on the fixed releases (2.541 weekly, 2.528.3 LTS). NVD publishes no Primary metric; its only metric is the CISA-ADP Secondary 3.5 LOW, which OSV/GHSA repeats as LOW, and the CNA has no metric, so all published levels are low. CWE-352 is recorded by NVD's Secondary source and by GHSA; the CNA lists none. The GHSA ECOSYSTEM weekly range introduced=2.529 conflicts with the CNA text and the CVE GIT range (introduced 0); this dataset follows the CNA and GIT range and records the conflict.

required_before_promotion: An independent reviewer must read AuthenticationProcessingFilter2 at 2.441 and confirm it registers the POST login matcher and never checks a crumb.
An independent reviewer must confirm the fix commits 31598feb/20bc304d add the attemptAuthentication crumb validation and are contained in releases 2.541 and 2.528.3.
An independent reviewer must confirm the affected range (weekly <=2.540, LTS <=2.528.2) and that 2.441 is inside it.
An independent reviewer must confirm all published severity levels are low (3.5) and record CWE-352.
An independent reviewer must confirm this entry is distinct from the other Jenkins CVEs in the dataset.
No formal reviews.jsonl row may be written until a named independent reviewer returns a verdict.

limitations: Static verification only; no Jenkins instance, HTTP request or test was run.

The practical impact requires a victim with an active browser session who is tricked into submitting the attacker's credentials; the advisory frames it as logging the user into the attacker's account.

When no CrumbIssuer is configured (crumbIssuer == null) the fixed code also performs no check; the fix's test covers that case, and this dataset records the advisory's affected range rather than narrowing it.
The attack page must submit the login form cross-origin; the fix addresses that by requiring a crumb, and the dataset records the mechanism without demonstrating it dynamically.
The GHSA ECOSYSTEM weekly range introduced=2.529 conflicts with the CNA and the CVE GIT range; the conflict is documented, not resolved silently.
open_questions: Whether any deployment disables crumbs by configuring a null CrumbIssuer was not enumerated; that configuration is outside the advisory's scope.
